newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico changes foreign investment reporting rules.
newsitem.headline: Mexico changes foreign investment reporting rules.

text.p: Mexico will broaden the definition of foreign investment that requires official registration in June, a Trade Ministry official said on Wednesday.

Foreign companies will need to register earnings reinvested, as well as investment or loans to foreign subsidiaries, at the Trade Ministry's foreign investment register, the official said in a telephone interview.
"Currently, foreign companies are only compelled to inform the foreign investment register of equity investment and this leaves out two other important items," he said.
